topic: Simplifying campaign parameter generation and retrieval
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on simplifying the process of generating and retrieving parameters for campaign scripts, as multiple requests were received regarding this complexity. Initial concerns included preventing users from extracting or downloading the script parameters. 

To simplify, [me] proposed modifying the dashboard script to require only visible inputs (email, dates, grouping, facility numbers, worker flags) at the top of the page. Metrics like dwell time, reach, and frequency would be automatically sourced from internal directories/reference data and applied to both the dashboard and campaign scripts.

[p1] suggested centralizing parameter retrieval by moving the logic into a helper function that all scripts could reference.
decisions: Parameters for campaign scripts will be generated using visible inputs (email, dates, facility numbers) and automatically sourced metrics (dwell time, reach, frequency).
action_items: [me] to modify the script parameters for the dashboard.
[me] to apply the same parameter modification approach to the campaign scripts.
